items.title_en: A High-Density EEG Dataset for Stimulus-Driven Auditory Attention
bullets_zh: 提出用于刺激驱动听觉注意的高密度EEG数据集。
面向无明确目标、多声源竞争下的无指令聆听场景。
支持非侵入式BCI的注意解码与基准评测研究。
bullets_en: Introduces a high-density EEG dataset for stimulus-driven auditory attention.
Targets instruction-free listening where multiple sound sources compete without an explicit goal.
Supports non-invasive BCI research on attention decoding and benchmarking.
items.brief: 提供高密度EEG数据集，支持无指令听觉注意解码与评测。
items.brief_en: Provides a high-density EEG dataset for instruction-free auditory attention decoding and evaluation.
items.raw_excerpt: Stimulus-driven auditory attention determines which sound gains priority when multiple sources compete without an explicit listening goal, yet most computational studies focus either on acoustic salience or on decoding predefined attended targets. items.title_zh: BCI-MCP 实时脑电状态MCP服务器
items.title_en: BCI-MCP Live EEG Brain-State MCP Server
bullets_zh: 将专注、平静、注意力等实时脑电状态接入Claude或任意MCP客户端。
实现面向非侵入式EEG设备的Model Context Protocol服务器与BCI工具包。
展示如何把消费级/科研EEG信号实时连接到LLM工作流。
bullets_en: Streams live EEG-derived brain states such as focus, calm, and attention into Claude or any MCP client.
Implements a Model Context Protocol server plus BCI toolkit for non-invasive EEG devices.
Shows how consumer/research EEG signals can be connected to LLM workflows in real time.
items.brief: BCI-MCP将实时EEG状态接入Claude/MCP，适合非侵入式脑机接口应用。
items.brief_en: BCI-MCP streams live EEG states into Claude/MCP clients, linking non-invasive BCI signals with LLM workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Stream live EEG brain state (focus, calm, attention) from any EEG device into Claude and any MCP client — a real Model Context Protocol server + brain-computer interface toolkit.

items.title_zh: EIDOS-BCI 模块化脑电信号处理框架
items.title_en: EIDOS-BCI Modular EEG Signal Processing Framework
bullets_zh: 提供基于Python/MNE的模块化框架，用于非侵入式BCI研究中的脑电信号处理。
面向可复现的信号处理流程，而非单一头显使用教程。
可作为EEG类BCI实验与分析的开源起点。
bullets_en: Provides a modular Python/MNE framework for processing EEG signals in non-invasive BCI research.
Targets reproducible signal-processing pipelines rather than a single headset tutorial.
Useful as an open-source starting point for EEG-based BCI experiments and analysis.
items.brief: EIDOS-BCI是Python/MNE模块化EEG处理框架，适合非侵入式BCI研究。
items.brief_en: EIDOS-BCI is a modular Python/MNE EEG processing framework for non-invasive BCI research and reproducible pipelines.
items.raw_excerpt: A modular EEG signal processing framework for Brain–Computer Interface (BCI) research using Python and MNE.

items.title_en: Trusted EEG Flow BCI Privacy Framework
bullets_zh: 提出非侵入式BCI中EEG数据流的隐私保护路径与可验证实践。
聚焦脑信号数据的可信处理，而非侵入式硬件或植入物。
适用于处理敏感神经数据的安全合规BCI研究流程。
bullets_en: Presents privacy-preserving pathways and verifiable practices for EEG data flow in non-invasive BCIs.
Focuses on trusted handling of brain-signal data rather than invasive hardware or implants.
Relevant to secure, compliant BCI research pipelines that process sensitive neural data.
